gateWhat.BOM: Quantities, colours per colourway and sizes; groups and sub-assemblies.
gateWhat.ROUTING: Operations with minutes above 0 and a scanned step.
gateWhat.SMV: Each governed operation uses its approved SMV; no SMV change waits for approval.
gateWhat.MATERIALS: Every material is approved for use; a blocked one stops the release.
gateWhat.PRICES: Every material the factory buys has a standard cost.
gateWhat.LABEL: The revision names an active garment label template.
gateWhat.CERTIFICATE: A valid certificate covers every switched-on colourway × size the release takes (PPE).
gateWhat.MEASUREMENTS: The revision's measurement spec is approved.
gateWhat.ATTRIBUTES: Every attribute the product type requires is filled.
gateWhat.CHANGE_ORDERS: The change order that proposes this draft is approved and in effect.
gateWhat.SCOPE: The colourways and sizes this release takes.
gateWhat.DRIFT: Quotes and orders on the revision that becomes obsolete keep it.

finding.ALTERNATE_BLOCKED: Line {line}: an alternate is a blocked material; remove it or take another one.
finding.SUB_ASSEMBLY_NOT_RELEASED: Line {line}: its sub-assembly is a draft or obsolete; take its released revision.
finding.SUB_ASSEMBLY_NOT_MADE: Line {line}: its sub-assembly is not a part we make (pieces, pairs or sets).
finding.SUB_ASSEMBLY_CIRCLE: Line {line}: the style is inside its own sub-assemblies.

finding.SUB_ASSEMBLY_UNIT: Line {line}: its unit does not convert to what the sub-assembly makes.

finding.SUB_ASSEMBLY_COLOURWAY_MISSING: Line {line}: the sub-assembly has no colourway {colourway}.
finding.GROUP_CIRCLE: Line {line}: it is grouped under a line grouped under it.
finding.PPE_MATERIAL_NOT_APPROVED: Line {line}: a PPE line whose material is not approved yet.
finding.ALTERNATE_ARCHIVED: Line {line}: an alternate is archived, so it is never taken.
finding.SUB_ASSEMBLY_STYLE_ARCHIVED: Line {line}: its sub-assembly is an archived style.
finding.SCOPE_REPEATED: A colourway or size is named twice.
finding.SCOPE_COLOURWAY_UNKNOWN: A colourway is not the style's.
finding.SCOPE_COLOURWAY_ARCHIVED: Colourway {colourway} is archived: it is not made, so it is not released.
finding.SCOPE_SIZE_OUTSIDE: Size {size} is not in the style's range.
finding.SCOPE_EMPTY: The release leaves nothing to make: release at least one active colourway in one size.

finding.SMV_NOT_APPROVED: Operation {step}: its minutes differ from the approved SMV in force.
finding.SMV_CHANGE_WAITING: Operation {step}: an SMV change waits for approval.
finding.MATERIAL_PENDING: Line {line}: the material is not approved for use yet.

finding.LABEL_MISSING: The revision names no garment label template.

finding.CERTIFICATE_NO_CELLS: No colourway in a size to check against a certificate yet.
finding.SPEC_MISSING: The revision has no measurement spec.

finding.CHANGE_ORDER_NOT_APPROVED: The change order that proposes this draft is not approved yet.

finding.OPEN_ORDERS: Open orders were taken on the revision that becomes obsolete.
